body: Explicit direction honored: stop test infrastructure and build the feature. Validated draft revision 2 (based on saved revision 7) moves all existing feature tickets from Sprint 2 into the active sprint, removes the now-empty intermediate sprint, and restores the original end-to-end goal/UI/lifecycle acceptance. No new tickets were created. DM-783 and unstarted DM-792 are optional/deferred; no additional probes or scheduling work will be dispatched. Accepted foundation/ownership/PTY work and all historical failures/NO-GO evidence remain recorded. Feature-specific Tests sections remain; complete DoD and actual Electron proof run at final feature acceptance only, with the existing prospective finite automation allowance. Validation: zero errors/warnings. Next executable feature is DM-721 management/read/retire/replace, then DM-741 publication and the existing implementation graph. Current session capability set still lacks plan.save: human Save/adoption is the sole remaining boundary before those feature claims; no manual sprint edits or new questionnaire required.
